title: Camp Cleanup
description: Count range pairs with full containment or any overlap.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse each line into four integers representing two ranges `[a, b]` and `[c, d]`.

## Part 1

Count pairs where one range fully contains the other: `a ≤ c` and `b ≥ d`, or vice versa.

## Part 2

Count pairs with any overlap. Two ranges overlap when `a ≤ d` and `c ≤ b`.
